svg.title: Execution: confirm with the user, then delete

g.text: Execution: confirm with the user, then delete
Parsing has produced a delete command for index 2; dispatch and index validation are condensed.
[book is empty, or index exceeds recipeCount]
No question is asked and nothing is deleted. The caller displays the error.
[answer is "y" or "yes", in any letter case]
findTarget repeats the size and index checks, because execute can also be called without a prompt.
[any other answer, or no more input]
execute is never called, so the book is unchanged.
Logging and getter details are condensed. ActiveMealPlan is not involved, so an existing
plan and its grocery list keep their original recipes.
